attchmntText: Religare Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about update on the governance review
voiceSummary: Religare Enterprises Limited Board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a net loss of 1,343.68 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 397.38 lakh rupees. The Board also tabled the final governance review report by M/s Trilegal dated November 9, 2026. The review covered the period from April 01, 2018 to February 28, 2025. The report found no adverse financial impact on the company. The company proposes to address identified governance areas in a phased manner. These areas include conflict identification, business rationale assessment, vendor selection, monitoring of deliverables, and expense governance.

attchmntText: Religare Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Options to purchase securities
voiceSummary: Religare Enterprises Limited granted 25,998 stock options under the Employee Stock Option Plan 2019. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant on November 12, 2026. Each option converts into one equity share with a face value of Rs. 10. The exercise price is Rs. 230.78 per share. The options vest in five equal annual installments of 20 percent each. The first installment vests one year after the grant date. Subsequent installments follow yearly. The remaining options vest in the fourth and fifth years. Holders may exercise the options within eight years from the vesting date. The scheme complies with SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity Regulations 2021. The options have not yet been exercised or lapsed.
